value.evidence_quote: SET 2ND WHIPSTOCK & MILLED WINDOW FROM 2178-2183 M. DRILLED 19 M FORMATION. CIRCULATED HOLE
value.note: window top; a first window (2202-2207 m, 1997-07-26) was abandoned
value.proposed_reason: Casing exit by a milled window: under the rule as ruled by TJ (decision 40) the kick-off is the top of the window, 2,178 m (window milled 2178-2183 m on 1997-07-29; an earlier window at 2,202-2,207 m was abandoned). NOD and the structured mdKickoff also say 2,178 m.

value.evidence_quote: DRESS CMT AND PERFORMED KICK OFF FROM 2231M TO 2277M.
value.proposed_reason: The report states the kick-off depth directly: 'DRESS CMT AND PERFORMED KICK OFF FROM 2231M TO 2277M'. NOD's 2,200 m is not an input to the rule; the only '2200' in the 19 A and 19 B reports is a clock time ('AT 2200 HRS').

value.evidence_quote: M;TOP OF SIDETRACK PLUG. DRILLED CMT. TO 2911 M. COMMENCED DRILLING 8 1/2" HOLE FROM
value.note: NOD has no separate record (its 15/9-19 B record is the B leg)
value.proposed_reason: The parent's last report states departure with a depth: 'COMMENCED DRILLING 8 1/2" HOLE FROM 2911 M AT 15/9-19BT2' (after cement drilled to 2911 m), and the first BT2 report starts at the same depth. Tier 1.

value.evidence_quote: (narratives of both 1992-12-19 reports are 'None'; md 1,536 on both)
value.alternative_depths: 1486 (parent drilled cement to 1,486 m the day before)
value.proposed_reason: Both 1992-12-19 narratives (parent last, sidetrack first) read 'None', so the third tier applies: measured depth at the transition, 1,536 m on both reports. Depth only, no text support; the parent had drilled cement to 1,486 m the day before, so the true departure could be shallower.

value.evidence_quote: shoe and rathole. Commenced kick off to F-1A
value.method: event in text, depth from md
value.note: event named in the parent's last report; md 2620
value.proposed_reason: The parent's last report says 'Commenced kick off to F-1A' without a depth and its md is 2620 m, so tier 2, event in text with depth from md. NOD agrees at 2,620 m.

value.evidence_quote: Drilled out cement and kicked off well to F-1 B.
value.method: event in text, depth from md
value.note: event named in the parent's last report; md 2617
value.proposed_reason: The parent's last report says 'Drilled out cement and kicked off well to F-1 B' and its md is 2617 m (2,545 m the day before), so tier 2, event in text with depth from md; the md is the day's deepest point, so the kick-off may be a little shallower (NOD 2,604 m).

value.evidence_quote: hole to 1355 m. Commenced time drilling to1364 m. 50% formation obtained at 1364 m.
value.note: new formation (50%) first reported at 1364 m
value.proposed_reason: Tier 1: the F-1 B report of 2014-02-22 states '50% formation obtained at 1364 m', the first report of new formation, and F-1 C's first report drills from 1,364 m. 1,355 m is only where time drilling started, the fallback used when no formation depth is stated. NOD agrees at 1,364 m.

value.evidence_quote: over pull. Milled 12-1/4" sidetrack window from 421,5 m (top) to 424 m. Note:Bottom window
value.proposed_reason: Casing exit by a milled window: kick-off = top of window, 421.5 m ('Milled 12-1/4" sidetrack window from 421,5 m (top) to 424 m'); the window bottom, 428.2 m, is not used (TJ ruling, decision 40). NOD gives 428 m.

value.evidence_quote: Ran wireline gyro. Washed down oriented to 246 m. Oriented drilled 26" hole from 246
value.note: start of oriented drilling out of the cement (TOC 244 m); NOD has no separate record
value.proposed_reason: No formation or departure depth is stated, so tier 2: the 2013-03-23 report says oriented drilling out of the cement started at 246 m (top of cement 244 m). 257 m is where the sidetrack was handed over the next day. NOD has no separate record.

value.evidence_quote: and kicked off to F-11 A at 2586m MD.
value.proposed_reason: Tier 1: 'Drilled cement and kicked off to F-11 A at 2586m MD' states the departure depth. NOD 2,578 m.

value.evidence_quote: new formation from 2531 m MD to 2589 m MD.
value.alternative_depths: 2531 (start of the cement and new-formation interval)
value.note: new formation reported by 2589 m; evidence is an interval 2531 to 2589 m
value.proposed_reason: LOW confidence. 'Drilled cement and new formation from 2531 m MD to 2589 m MD' reports new formation by the end of the interval, so departure is confirmed at 2,589 m, consistent with F-1 C (formation first reported); the interval start, 2,531 m, is not used (TJ ruling, decision 40). NOD gives 2,586 m, inside the interval.

value.evidence_quote: Drilled cement/new formation from 1368 m to 1381 m MD. Initiated kick off of F-15.
value.proposed_reason: 'Drilled cement/new formation from 1368 m to 1381 m MD. Initiated kick off of F-15.' puts the start of the kick-off at the end of the interval, 1,381 m, where the sidetrack's first report also starts. NOD agrees at 1,381 m.

value.evidence_quote: Drilled 8½" hole from 3141m to 3185m and kicked off at 3185m continued drilling
value.proposed_reason: Tier 1: 'kicked off at 3185m' states the departure depth; the '50/50 cement/formation' remark relates to 3,210 m, drilled afterwards. NOD agrees at 3,185 m.

value.evidence_quote: OBM. Drilled cement from 2490 m to 2566 m MD. Initiated kick off and drilled
value.alternative_depths: 2575 (depth the section reached; the NOD value)
value.note: kick-off initiated after cement drilled to 2566 m
value.proposed_reason: Tier 2: cement was drilled from 2,490 to 2,566 m, then 'Initiated kick off', and no formation or departure depth is stated; 2,575 m (the NOD value) is only where the section had reached by the end of the day.

value.evidence_quote: BHA. Drilled cement and kicked off. Drilled 17 1/2" hole.
value.method: event in text, depth from md
value.note: parent set kick-off plug 2013-11-10; child's first report says 'kicked off' without a depth
value.proposed_reason: The sidetrack's first report says 'Drilled cement and kicked off' without a depth, so tier 2 with depth from md: the parent's last report (kick-off plug set the day before) has md 1,380 m. NOD agrees at 1,380 m.
